_comment: Accepted codegen-differential defects, per (component, attribute, platform, check). An entry means the converter demonstrably fails that judgement and the failure is accepted FOR A STATED REASON — not that it is fine. Unrecorded defects fail `jui conformance gate --codegen-effect`; entries the measurement no longer supports are stale and fail too, so fixing a defect forces its row out (the one-directional version lets a fixed row sit here forever, which is how the previous freeze ledgers rotted). Advisory classes (value-is-default, numeric-string-divergence) are re-derived every run and are deliberately absent. Reason 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' marks the initial-measurement backlog — consume it.

entries.owner: E (SSoT) — recorded per 49 ruling; implementation is post-release work
entries.reason: Declared styled face unimplemented, scheduled post-release. The boolean face WORKS on all three platforms: presence is read and the line is drawn (the emit differs from the control). Only the object face's contents (lineStyle, color) are unread — `true` and a styled object emit byte-identical text. Do not read this row as 'strikethrough does not work'.
entries.note: Same family as the declared-but-unimplemented spellings (B's ledger). F's dynamic fix (91a57bc) made the node survive the object face; it did not add style drawing. D's __styled fixtures stay: round 5 verifies node-survives + both faces render the same picture until styling lands.

entries.owner: E (SSoT) — contract, no implementation is owed on this face
entries.reason: Contract, not a gap. The collectionSeparators ruling (2026-08-07, raised by B) settles it: the ios probe path is CollectionStackView, not SwiftUI's List, and a container that draws no separators satisfies 'hide the separators' VACUOUSLY. 'Implement it' must not mean 'switch the container to a List' — an attribute that reshapes the thing it modifies is the defect family this wave exists to remove. The coverage row is runtime-only: the ios DYNAMIC path implements it; no codegen face does, by contract.

entries.owner: A (rjui) — probe value fix owned by D
entries.reason: NOT an unread spelling. collection_converter.rb:149-151 reads it and every container branch acts on it: static `none` drops the overflow scroll classes (measured: CONTROL/lazy/eager byte-identical, none differs), and the bound form emits a runtime overflow override in all three branches. The C0 verdict is an artifact of the value plan: representative_value('Collection','lazy') is 'lazy' — the declared DEFAULT — so emit(v1) equals the control by construction, and the second value 'eager' also equals it because lazy-vs-eager is virtualization, which the plain `.map()` emit does not have. `none` is the only web-observable value and the probe never picks it.
entries.note: Accepted degeneracy: web lazy≡eager (no virtualization to switch off). Probe fix: representative value `none` in rules.py (D's file, not touched here).

entries.reason: Declared 2026-08-07 (51-E canonical/scope batch): the spelling entered the probe surface when the declaration landed, and this face has not implemented the read. Not a regression — the attribute never worked on this face; the declaration made the gap measurable. The implementation queue row lives in conformance/coverage.json under the same owner; when the face lands, this row goes stale and the gate says to remove it (that is the designed lifecycle, not a leak).

entries.owner: E ruling — vacuous outside List (see reason)
entries.reason: Ruled 2026-08-07 (51-E, asked by B): a container that is not a List has no separator to hide — the only separator emission on any face is the List path, and the probe layout does not reach it. Contract is a vacuous no-op outside List contexts; coverage marks the attribute runtime-only. Do not read this row as an implementation gap.

The fit-to-box implementation (51-A, commit 6bffb03/80638a7 family) lives at RUNTIME in the web component: the emitted text does not change with the declared value by design, so C0/C1 fire on emit while the behaviour is implemented. Companion adjudication in cross_effect.json (fixture shape cannot observe the shrink without a height constraint; D reshaped in 170121d). Verify via render, not emit.

The ios Button face has not implemented fontFamily: the dynamic ButtonConverter never reads it and StateAwareButtonView's initializer has no parameter for it. The codegen emit passed the argument anyway and had never compiled — the first Button/fontFamily fixture (51-D bound-fixture batch) failed the codegen host build ('extra argument in call'), so the emit was removed to restore codegen ≡ dynamic (both unread). Not a regression — the attribute never rendered on this face. When the face lands (library + dynamic + codegen together), this row goes stale and the gate says to remove it.
